ios.desc:
Meet Aiden, your private, on‑device assistant designed to help you move through your day—without sending your data anywhere. Aiden runs locally on your device, so it’s fast, reliable, and works even when you’re offline.

With thoughtfully designed widgets powered by WidgetKit, Aiden brings useful, glanceable insights to your Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy—no taps required. Capture quick thoughts, plan your day, and stay on top of events and reminders, all with privacy at the core.

What makes Aiden different:
• On‑device intelligence: Your content and actions are processed locally for speed and privacy.
• Works offline: Notes, reminders, events, and widgets function without a connection.
• Glanceable widgets: See what matters at a glance across iPhone, iPad, and macOS.
• Smart updates: Timely, relevant information that refreshes when you need it.
• Respect for your data: No accounts. No cloud servers. No tracking.

Everything you can do with Aiden
• Notes
   • Create, edit, tag, and categorize notes (Work, Personal, Ideas, Tasks, Meeting, Strategy, Finance, and more).
   • Fast search across titles, content, and tags.
   • List or grid layouts with grouping by month and sorting options.
• Reminders
   • Add reminders with date/time, notes, priority, and categories.
   • Recurring reminders with flexible patterns (e.g., weekly).
   • Local notifications with multiple reminder times (at time, 15m, 1h, 1d, etc.) and overdue nudges.
   • Actionable notifications: Mark Complete or Reschedule right from the alert.
• Events
   • Organize and review events with powerful filters: Today, This Week, Upcoming, Past, Overdue.
   • Grid or list views, search, and sort by start/end date, title, or priority.
   • Optional iOS Calendar integration (with your permission) to sync and view calendar events.
   • Local event notifications: before-event reminders, daily summary, follow‑ups, and overdue checks.
   • Pre‑Meeting Brief flow: get a concise briefing with related tasks pulled from your on‑device data.
• Widgets
   • Home Screen, Lock Screen, and StandBy support for quick, glanceable insights.
   • Designed to be fast, readable, and helpful at a glance.
• Privacy & Control
   • On‑device by default: data is stored locally and processed on your device.
   • Works offline: capture, search, and manage anywhere.
   • Optional system integrations (Calendar, Notifications) with clear permission prompts.
• Design
   • Clean, production‑quality UI with adaptive theming

show_hn.title: Show HN: Aiden AI – An Executive Assistant App for Founders and Professionals

quotes.text:
Hi HN,
I built Aiden AI as a privacy-first executive assistant app that works fully offline on iPhone. It helps startup founders, busy professionals, and executives stay focused, take notes, organize schedules, and get intelligent summaries — all without sharing their data with any server.

Built using Core ML and SwiftUI, it’s designed for performance and privacy. I’d love your feedback and suggestions to improve it!

Happy to answer any questions.
